'''Hylo Visz's father''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] designer living on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] with his [[Hylo Visz's mother|wife]] and [[Hylo Visz|daughter]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Mirialan was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the Empire's initial raid on the planet during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]]. His wife and daughter made it off the world, however his wife died shortly after on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], leaving Hylo orphaned. His daughter would go on to become a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-renowned [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. The day prior to his death, his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] broke down, an event that led to Hylo's belief in the [[Invisible Law of the Universe]].
